rule: Engine-side damage gate for a final boss: if the boss is flagged final, the damage function returns before any damage, unless the inflictor is the one allowed kind (the d3xp path names one projectile; the older build allows the soul-cube missile). Each joint has a damage multiplier that defaults to 1.0; hits apply ceil(damage x scale) by hit location. A player's projectile explosion on an actor with health left adds the actor's remaining health to the player's pool, except for actors with the boss spawn-arg. The end-boss beam end point is set from the Chest1 joint position.
keep: One allowed hit kind for a final boss, so the player learns one answer
Per-body-part damage multiplier as data, default 1.0
No health-pool reward from boss kills
change: Do not hard-code one projectile name in the engine; list allowed hit kinds per boss as data
Beam aim on a named zone of the creature, not a joint string
Blocked hits must show client feedback (donor gives none in the code read)
look_test: Target file src/fight/hit-zones.ts (new), parity row 7 (creature actor, zones). On an existing creature in the fight scene, flag head x2 and torso x1 and one only-this-hits boss rule. Dom taps with a normal hit and a special hit and judges whether the blocked-hit flash reads at 375 wide.
